value.rationale: A complete arithmetic classification of both intrinsically defined parity spin schemes for every smooth genus-four hyperelliptic curve over odd finite fields, not a family-specific numerical table. It exhibits two unavoidable information-loss pairs under theta descent and an optimal finite-field extension bound (five) to recover the entire pair of theta-scheme zeta functions. Such explicit descent and reconstruction information is relevant to arithmetic spin geometry and is not implied solely by the number of rational theta classes.
